answer: Bind each agent to one scuba-diver certification. A dive agency issues the card only after in-water training and an exam, then signs a fresh challenge tying the agent's key to that certification number, re-checked against the agency's diver registry every epoch. A second key claiming the same card is rejected. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 certified divers at roughly $500 each for the course, gear rental and logged dives, about $500,000. Training happens in the ocean, over basalt reefs, and every dive goes in the log, so the delta between a real logbook and a bought card shows at once.
